audit: Region-stratified nonlinear mutual-information redundancy screen for Tm2/Tm3/Tm5; diagnostic only

method.candidate_scope: Each Tm2, Tm3, and Tm5 emission is compared with every registered emission from a different policy-cleared idea; each unordered cross-idea pair is measured once. This includes cross-pairs among Tm2/Tm3/Tm5; same-idea emissions are not paired.
method.continuous_binning: For each feature separately, calculate deterministic empirical deciles within each region from that feature's own defined values (NumPy linear quantiles at 0.1..0.9); assign with searchsorted(side=right). Ties may collapse bins.
method.categorical_encoding: Integer-valued features with at most 10 unique values are retained as categorical levels; other features use the within-region empirical-decile encoding.
method.pairwise_definedness: Only jointly defined finite values are used for each pair in each region; encodings/decile cutpoints are computed before pairwise masking.
method.nmi: Symmetric arithmetic normalization 2*MI/(H(X)+H(Y)) with natural logarithms; zero-entropy pairs map to 0. NMI is calculated only at joint count >=30 and lies in [0,1].
method.flag_rule: Flag a feature pair if its maximum region NMI is > 0.8; the threshold is strictly greater-than.

acceptance.interpretation: No region-stratified nonlinear redundancy flag exceeded NMI 0.8; retain all existing estimators.
